svg.title: Derivation map
svg.desc: Nine blocks derive every table from the metric and the orientation of the volume element, in the order of the code: bases, metric, parts, transitional products, interior products, geometric products, norms, properties and projections. Each box holds a symbol, and each anti table stands under its base. Each line carries its formula and the function that builds the table. Faded lines are routes that the code does not take, and faded boxes are operators with no table.
